name: 3 Steps to Spanish Fluency: Online Workshops Austin
description:
This group is for people wishing to learn Spanish to a high level of competency, especially if they have had trouble progressing in the past and are looking for a new way to improve.
The group workshops are hosted by Francis Collier and are free and open to anyone interested.
More information on paid courses is available at the end of the workshop for anyone looking to improve further.
The 3 Step Process:
Step 1: The 12 Sounds.
In Spanish there are 12 new sounds that do not exist in English.
The first step in the process to fluency is to learn ALL of these sounds CORRECTLY.
If you don't know what all of these sounds are please be advised Francis Collier will take everyone through them in the workshop.
Step 2: Native Phrases.
Very often Spanish learners when presented with a native level conversation find it sounds "too fast" and they can't keep up.
Commonly there are two things that are going wrong in this step.
Reason 1. The 12 new sounds in Spanish have not been learnt and therefore the fundamental building blocks required are not there.
Reason 2. The student cannot recognise the Native Phrases used as they do not know them and have not practised recognising them. This can often happen because the student is still translating in their head from English.
What are Native Phrases?
They are combinations of words that are used so commonly in a language that they are squeezed together and said very quickly.
Think of the way someone might say “What do you want?” to their friend if they are in a drive through. It’s more like “wadayawan?”
It’s exactly the same in Spanish, there are many native phrases that native speakers say every day and practising to recognise these at speed is crucial in order to understand real conversation.
Step 3: Real Conversations at Native Speed.
The third step is to practise in a conversation at REAL Native Speed.
Imagine learning to play baseball and spending hours reading books on base ball, watching and analysing old games but never playing a real game at real speed.
How long do you think it would take to get good?
This being a bad idea seems very obvious in the example above but this is what so many students do with apps and books and movies when learning a language and many of them never reach fluency with this approach.
So if you are interested in coming along and learning more about the process to Spanish fluency and how to improve your Spanish then please sign up for one of our workshops.
To sign up for the workshop go to the event page and click the on "Attend" button for the workshop link.
Good luck and we hope to see you soon.
As perpolicy: Attendees under the age of 18 must have a guardian with them.

name: Introduction to The Gurdjieff Work
description:
The aim of this Meet Up is to help people approach and appreciate the psychological ideas ofthe Gurdjieff Work. This is a public discussion forum rather than a "lecture style" meeting. However, itmixesboth elements. The intended form of the meeting is:
• Each meeting lasts about 90 minutes.
• Meetings are led by a member of the group, usually the group leader.
• Each meeting is themed around the discussion of a particularconcept from The Work.
• Questions and exchanges of ideas are invited and welcomed.
• The intention is that attendees acquire a deeper knowledge of The Work from the meeting.
It is advised that only people who have some familiarity with The Gurdjieff Work (for example those who have at the very least read about it) attend. The meeting assumes at least a little knowledge. However, It is not absolutely necessary to have read any of the books written directly by Gurdjieff, but experience of this may help.
The Meet Up is usually led by Robin Bloor. His lineage is that he was (from 1988) a pupil of Rina Hands, who was herself a pupil both of P.D. Ouspensky and G. I. Gurdjieff.
He is also the author of the two books;To Fathom The Gist Volume 1: Approaches to The Writings of G. I. Gurdjieff, and To Fathom The Gist Volume 2: The Arch-Absurd.
Gurdjieff's magnum opus, Beelzebub's Tales to His Grandson is, perhaps, the only example of Objective Literature available to us in our time. Reading it requires both effort and knowledge, but it is accessible.

name: Russian/Eastern European poetry exchange
description:
We started our poetry exchange meetings early in 2015 to present our own poems and share samples of contemporary Russian poetry. Since then, we have been meeting approximately once in a month, each time with a selected major topic or author to present. We accept all Slavic languages, contemporary, ancient and formation-stage (e.g. Siberian).
We usually read in rounds; responses to the previous reader are welcome but not obligatory. Bring your own masterpieces, or your friends', or any verses you'd like to share, or bring nothing and just come to attend - there is no obligatory degree of participation:) Both native speakers and language learners are welcome; translation service is provided on demand.
We don't promise exhaustive coverage of Russian or Eastern European poetry, but do promise abroadcoverage of it. If you think we are undeservedly underserving a particular topic, let us know, or simply come and share - we love collaborative research!
Let you know if you'd like to see a poem translated to/from Russian or Ukrainian.

name: Austin Storytelling Events
description:
This is a meetup for all those who love telling stories or hearing them told. While other arts have evolved or changed throughout history, oral storytelling, the world's original art form, remains largely the same. With the human voice as its brush, and the evening campfire, mountain path, or busy city square as its canvas, no two stories are alike: audience, orator, and environment combine to create a unique and unforgettable moment in history. It is the art of caves and castles, of weddings and war-time, whether sitting in front of grandpa's chair or speaking at his funeral: storytelling unites us.
A little about me: I am a full-time Chinese-English translator with a background in education and a Master's in Taiwanese Folklore Studies from UT. I teach a Chinese class at Southwestern University and enjoy solo hikes, running groups, and watching the never-ending cycle of Star Wars shows on Disney+ with my girlfriend. While my background is in myth/folklore, I am passionate about community storytelling events like The Moth and Hyde Park Storytelling, and I always do my best to attend them when I can.
The goal is to host small, simple outdoor storytelling events once or twice a week at various locations around Austin, where people can gather, enjoy a beverage, and listen to each other's stories. We will have "Story Practice" events, chances to improve your skills and gain confidence, and I will post my more formal events where I will be speaking at UT, Southwestern, etc.
For practice events, storytellers can simply show up, tell a story or just join in on our discussion, and get feedback from people if they so choose. I will begin with an introduction to the theme for the night, then we will move into informal brainstorming activities designed to familiarize ourselves with each other and get the creative juices flowing. You can prepare a short 5-10 minute history, personal narrative, folk or fairy tale, etc., but you're more than welcome to just come and listen. All are welcome, no exceptions. Events and times will be posted on Meetup.
We hope to see you there!

name: Austin Mahjong Social Club
description:
Welcome Mahjong lovers! This group is for Austin, Texas and surrounding cities. If you do not reside in this area and do not plan on attending the events, please do not join this group.
We are a couple of Hong Kong style Mahjong players looking for beginner and advanced players to join our group. We welcome players who want to share and coach their Mahjong versions like American, Japanese, Vietnamese, etc, style Mahjong. We mostly play Hong Kong / Chinese style right now, and it's very easy to learn. Please don't be afraid to join. We will expand to more versions as we get volunteer coaches. Let us know if you want to lead a mahjong game. We can certainly use the help.
Group rulesYou must RSVP in order to play.
We need four players for Mahjong. When RSVPs are three or less, we may cancel the game. Each event has space for 4 to 8 players, and if all 8 are attending, we can have two tables. Mahjong is played with a table of four. If you don't show up, it affects everyone's ability play. For this reason we now track "no shows" and two no shows will be permanently removed from the group. Also, if you join a game, and then cancel after the close of the RSVPs, it's difficult for people on the waitlist to join. They have usually made other plans. If you cancel late, it will be counted as a "no show." So please plan accordingly. Please be courteous to the organizers and other members.
If you change your mind about attending, please change your RSVP to "not going." Please check your Meetup messages the night before the event for updates or changes to the event. We often move the first four players on the WAITLIST. If you are one of the first four people on the waitlist, and you can't make it, please remove yourself from the waitlist.
The best way to learn Mahjong is by playing. But if you're shy or nervous about starting, you can come and observe the game. Please post in the event comments if you want to do that so we can get to know you. You don't have to RSVP.
Mahjong!

name: Austin Mahjong Social Club
description:
Welcome Mahjong lovers! This group is for Austin, Texas and surrounding cities. If you do not reside in this area and do not plan on attending the events, please do not join this group.
We are a couple of Hong Kong style Mahjong players looking for beginner and advanced players to join our group. We welcome players who want to share and coach their Mahjong versions like American, Japanese, Vietnamese, etc, style Mahjong. We mostly play Hong Kong / Chinese style right now, and it's very easy to learn. Please don't be afraid to join. We will expand to more versions as we get volunteer coaches. Let us know if you want to lead a mahjong game. We can certainly use the help.
Group rulesYou must RSVP in order to play.
We need four players for Mahjong. When RSVPs are three or less, we may cancel the game. Each event has space for 4 to 8 players, and if all 8 are attending, we can have two tables. Mahjong is played with a table of four. If you don't show up, it affects everyone's ability play. For this reason we now track "no shows" and two no shows will be permanently removed from the group. Also, if you join a game, and then cancel after the close of the RSVPs, it's difficult for people on the waitlist to join. They have usually made other plans. If you cancel late, it will be counted as a "no show." So please plan accordingly. Please be courteous to the organizers and other members.
If you change your mind about attending, please change your RSVP to "not going." Please check your Meetup messages the night before the event for updates or changes to the event. We often move the first four players on the WAITLIST. If you are one of the first four people on the waitlist, and you can't make it, please remove yourself from the waitlist.
The best way to learn Mahjong is by playing. But if you're shy or nervous about starting, you can come and observe the game. Please post in the event comments if you want to do that so we can get to know you. You don't have to RSVP.
Mahjong!

name: Asians in ATX
description:
Thanks for checking out our group! We’re agroup dedicated to Asians in the ATX and surrounding areas! This groups’ goal is to create an open and friendly community environment that enables Asians to connect with one another, through participation of fun social events and activities together, hosted by our volunteer organizers!
To further enhance our community engagement and keep the conversation going beyond our events, we invite you to join our Discord server. Here, you'll find a vibrant space to share experiences, coordinate for upcoming gatherings, or simply hang out and chat with fellow members. It’s a great way to stay connected, meet new friends, and be part of our growing community.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Who should join:Asians living in Austin and the surrounding area who would like to connect with other Asians living in the area. This group is not exclusively for Asians (all are welcome to join!) but its events and activities will be Asian-themed.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Why you should join:-> To participate in fun social outings like dining out, picnics, BBQs, board games, sport activities, hiking, and other fun social activities!-> To network with like-minded people by sharing your experiences and providing advice-> To meet other fun Asians in the area
->But most importantly, to have fun!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Safety and Zero Tolerance Harassment Policy
Acts of harassment, racism, intimidation, or similar acts, in person or online, are strictly prohibitedWe strive on maintaining a friendly, safe, and positive social environment for all our members to enjoy social events together.Sending unsolicited messages to other members of the group is strictly prohibited. If you feel you are being spammed or harassed through these type of messages, please reach out to the team. Violators will be banned from the group permanently.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
RSVP & Attendance Policy:We put a lot of effort in planning and organizing events to provide a fun and enjoyable experience for everyone. Therefore, when you RSVP “YES” to an event, you are expected to commit to your RSVP to the event and observe the RSVP policies.

If event organizers believe an attendee's intentions do not align with these principles, we reserve the right to remove the individual from the event or the group. If you have any objections to such decisions, please emailThank you for your understanding and cooperation.RSVP Cancellation Deadline: Each event will have a RSVP cancellation deadline. This deadline can be found on the event description page. This is essentially the last day you can cancel your RSVP. After this deadline, you are considered to your RSVP to the event. If you need to cancel, please cancel before the deadline.
-> Late Bail Out: If you cancel your RSVP after the RSVP cancellation deadline (see #1 above), you are now considered to have Late Bailed Out for the event. You will receive a strike on your record
-> No Show: If you've confirmed your attendance (RSVP'd "YES") for an event but fail to attend, you will be marked as a "No-Show." Accumulating one "No-Show" puts you at risk of being bumped for future events, giving priority to those on the waitlist. Three "No-Show" incidents will result in immediate removal from the group.

If you show up at an event without prior RSVPing or have not obtained permission from the organizer of the event without RSVP’ing, you will cause issues for the organizer. This behavior will receive a strike on your record.

Strikes may be removed given the attendee has had 5 consecutive events with no issues. Please contact the team to request removal of the strike.
-> Inviting guests to events: Some events may allow members to invite guest(s) to attend the event. If you would like to bring a friend to an event, please note all rules & policies will also apply to your guest on your behalf. All policy violations associated with your guest will be reflected on your record. description:
Welcome to our diverse community of writers and readers! Our monthly social gathering is a safe and inclusive space where we explore stories from all backgrounds and perspectives. Our discussions revolve around sharing our favorite books, with a focus on diverse and usually South-Asian literature.

description:
Hi everyone! My name is Simon. I decided to create this group in hopes of bringing like minded people together to have a great time making/eating amazing Korean food (more than just kimbap), enjoying hobbies, and more random activities together!

name: Arab Culture Enthusiasts
description:
Welcome to the Arab Culture Enthusiasts – a vibrant community dedicated to exploring, learning, and celebrating the rich tapestry of Arab heritage! Our group is a melting pot of individuals passionate about delving into the diverse facets of Arab culture, from history and traditions to art, cuisine, music, and beyond.
Join us on a fascinating journey as we unravel the stories, customs, and artistic expressions that make the Arab world unique. Through engaging discussions, interactive events, and immersive experiences, we aim to foster a deeper understanding and appreciation for the beauty and complexity of Arab cultures.Whether you're an avid learner, a seasoned enthusiast, or someone simply curious about Arab heritage, our group provides a welcoming space for everyone to come together, share insights, and build connections. Let's embrace the spirit of unity in diversity as we embark on this enlightening exploration of Arab culture. Together, we celebrate the past, present, and future of the Arab world!
We will communicate in English but also in MSA (Modern Standard Arabic) if you are fluent in the language or in any Arabic dialect (Levantine, Egyptian, North African, Iraqi, etc).

description: Welcome to the Austin Arabic Meetup Group! This group is dedicated to promoting the study and appreciation of the Arabic language. Whether you are a beginner or advanced learner, this is the perfect platform to practice Arabic conversation skills, exchange language resources, and engage with fellow Arabic enthusiasts. Join us for weekly language study sessions, cultural events, and fun outings as we delve into the rich world of Arabic language and culture. Let's come together to enhance our Arabic skills and foster a supportive community of learners in Austin!

description: Welcome to the Austin Arabic Exchange Meetup Group! This group is for anyone interested in language practice relating to Arabic culture language and literature. Whether you're a beginner or fluent speaker, come join us to meet new people, practice your language skills, and immerse yourself in the beauty of Arabic languages and cultures. We believe in fostering a supportive and inclusive community where members can learn from each other and grow together. Let's come together to celebrate our shared love for Arabic languages and cultures! Join us for some fun and enlightening meetups. Hope to see you there!

description: Opportunity to get togther in an informal setting to discuss and learn about True Islam. Ask any questions you have about Islam and Islamic beliefs and practices and share your own thoughts on religion and spirituality. Open to all, whatever community of faith (or no faith) that you belong to. For more information about True Islam, go to

name: Agnostic Muslims in Austin
description:
Many of us who were born and raised Muslim have complicated relationships with the theological and social teachings of Islam, yet we retain some of the cultural aspects of the religion and don't want to cut ourselves off entirely from our families. This feels like an under-explored perspective among Muslims - we don't have a well-established term for someone who shares such views. Inspired by this excellent essay (https://thecompanion.in/being-an-agnostic-muslim/), I chose the term "agnostic Muslim" for now.

This is a difficult position to occupy, and I found myself craving the company of like-minded people. Let's see if we can form a community to share ideas, make new connections, and support each other!

name: Come Let's Learn Hindi
description:
NamasteThis group is for those who would like to start speaking, understanding, reading and writing Hindi.The sessions here follow an interactive approach to learning Hindi and each session with different methods helps to gradually and consistently develop Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening skills in the Hindi.We are here to help you learn Hindi language in a fun-filled way.Learning a second or third language is a very powerful tool in an ever shrinking world. So sign up for hands on, activity based Hindi language Session. Kids will learn Hindi conversational Hindi, the alphabet and rudimentary writing as well. Language will be introduced via songs, stories, role play and various other friendly activities.
Hindi Varnamala
![img](http://www.hindilearner.com/Images/hindi.gif)

Here you can familiarize yourself with theHindi alphabet - Hindi Varnamala.Hindi is mostly written in a script called Nagari or Devanagari. Hindi is normally spoken using a combination of 52 sounds - 10 vowels, 40 consonants, nasalization and a kind of aspiration. These sounds are represented in the Devanagari script by 52 symbols: for 10 vowels, 2 modifiers and 40 consonants. You will also need to learn to recognize a character that traditionally represented a vowel but does not any longer, and four common conjunct consonants, which is actually a total of 57 symbols to remember to begin with.Once you have learned the basic characters you will then be easily able to learn the shorthand (matra) symbols for the vowels and the conjunct characters.
![img](http://photos1.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/8/8/3/6/event_17614870.jpeg)

name: Vedic Satsang
description: Interested in Vedic philosophy and want to meet others with a similar interest? Our group aims to build a community of people interested in studying and living the teachings of the Vedas in the modern world. This group aims to find synthesis in the various strands of Vedic philosophy without being held to one particular path or guru. Ideal group members would be students of Vedic philosophy, Hatha yoga teachers and practitioners, Tantric/kundalini practitioners, Ayurvedic practitioners, Desis/Hindus that want non-denominational fellowship and curious others who may want to learn more about Vedic philosophy but are not sure where to start! Ideally meetings will bring variety of activities: study circles of scriptures, asana sessions, bhajans, visiting local Hindu Temples, Indian restaurants, guest speakers (Swamis, etc) and more!

name: Inner Engineering Austin (Isha Yoga & Meditation Classes)
description:
"If life were to come with a manual, this in my opinion would be it! If we all applied the Inner Engineering technology, our world would instantly transform to exist from a foundation of peace, joy, and compassion for all beings."  -Evita Ochel
For all of the strides we have made in science and technology with standards of living unimaginable a century ago, most human beings still remain in search of wholeness and purpose in their lives.is scientifically-structured to offer powerful processes from the ancient tradition of yoga to transcend the limitations of who you are and bring you to higher levels of consciousness.  Inner Engineering was designed by Sadhguru, a yogi, visionary, and one the foremost authorities on yoga as a powerful tool to create your life the way you want it.

Sadhguru & Deepak Chopra— Creating Inner Peace, Joy and Fulfillment in a Hectic Modern World
"The word 'yoga' means union, that means you experience the entire universe as yourself...by working with the body, by working with the mind, by working with your emotion and energy, you can setup a step-by- step system within yourself where your energies are kept at such a level of exuberance that your sensory body is as large as the universe...Once you experience everybody around you as yourself... your goodness is a consequence, not an effort."

About Sadhguru—Sadhguru is a realized yogi and mystic – a man whose passion spills into everything he encounters. With a keen mind, balanced by a heart that knows no boundary, his presence and powerful yoga programs create an extraordinary opportunity to break through limitations into one’s natural state of freedom, love and joy.
Sadhguru has a unique ability to make the ancient science of yoga relevant to contemporary minds. Sadhguru serves as a bridge to the deeper dimensions of life. His approach does not ascribe to any belief system, but offers methods for self-transformation that are both proven and powerful.
An author, poet and internationally renowned speaker, Sadhguru’s wit and piercing logic provoke and broaden our thoughts and perception of the meaning of life, the very purpose of life. Sadhguru has been an influential voice at major global forums including the UN, MIT, TED, and the World Economic Forum.
Sadhguru established Isha Foundation, a non-profit organization supported by over two million volunteers worldwide. From powerful yoga programs and meditation practices to large-scale humanitarian projects, the foundation’s activities are designed to create an inclusive culture and establish global harmony, earning a special consultative status with the United Nations.
Sadhguru at Emory University—  "Consciousness and living well are not in conflict with each other...  "

------------------
Isha Kriya Guided Meditation—Jump Right In... Learn to Meditate NOW!
These 1-hour guided meditation sessions offer a simple, but powerfulkriyapractice that aligns your mind, body, and inner-energies to elevate your conscious awareness and easily and naturally achieve a state of deep meditation. Once you are meditative on a daily basis, your experience of the life within you and the world around you becomes much richer. Daily meditation makes your life stress-free, effortless and joyful!
You can easily learn this 12-to-18 minute Isha Kriya process in a convenient, online meditation class, or through a live, free meditation class near you.  Our online formats include our streaming guided meditation video, the Isha Kriya meditation app (for iphone & android devices), and weekly webinars hosted by trained teachers who can answer your questions about the practice.  Local sessions are hosted regularly to enhance and deepen the experience of meditation with the group.
Benefits of regular Isha Kriya meditation practice include improving health, energy and vitality; enhancing mental focus, memory and clarity; reducing stress and establishing a deep sense of peace and inner balance.
Isha Kriya is a simple, gentle guided meditation that can be done seated cross-legged on the floor or sitting in a chair. No previous meditation experience is necessary.

Take a  Deeper Step...Create a Life of Total Wellbeing—
“Inner Engineering is neither a religion, nor a philosophy or dogma. It is a technology for wellbeing. One does not have to believe or disbelieve--just have to learn to use...  Technology will produce results irrespective of who you are.” –Sadhguru
Inner Engineering is a 7-session online course that gives you the opportunity to intellectually explore the ABC’s of life using methods that are the distilled essence of yogic sciences. The course imparts practical wisdom to manage your body, mind, emotions, and the fundamental life energy within.
Program components include:
• Enlightening interactive sessions
• Guided meditations
•Asanas, simple yoga postures.
• Shambhavi Mahamudra, a powerful , 21-minute inner-energy technique that brings your entire system into alignment so that your body, mind, emotions and energies function in harmony.

****

The Isha Institute of Inner-sciencesis a breathtaking mountain retreat for stress relief, rejuvenation, and complete inner well-being. The retreat offers yoga in its purest form, through experiential classical yoga and meditation classes, and powerfully energized meditation spaces such as the Adi Yogi: The Abode of Yoga.

A Serene Mountain Getaway to Learn Classical Yoga:Relax and rejuvenate at the Isha yoga retreat—
The Isha Institute of Inner-sciences is a world-class yoga center offering classical yoga and meditation classes from beginner to advanced levels. Guests journey from around the globe to visit this unique destination to relax, reflect, and reconnect with nature in this tranquil oasis nestled in Tennessee’s spectacular Upper Cumberland.
Drop-by for a Day Visit
The Isha retreat center offers campus tours daily that include light hikes to one of many beautiful bluff vistas or waterfalls and a visit insideMahima,the largest yoga and meditation hall in the western hemisphere! Several free yoga classes and guided meditation sessions are available each day.  Inquire with the main office for details.
Hiking and Mountain Biking on Pristine Forested Trails
The Isha retreat center also offers myriad opportunities for hiking and mountain biking on forested trails winding throughout nearly 1400 acres. The center's five miles of mountain biking trails have been professionally classified from beginner to intermediate skill levels, with steep climbs, water features, and tight switchbacks on the more challenging portions. The trails are part of an expanding network of over 15 miles of hiking and biking trails featuring beautiful waterfalls, a meandering spring-fed creek, and breathtaking bluff overlooks.
Relaxation & Wellness Retreats
Overnight stays include the option of private studio accommodations, delicious vegetarian buffet meals, and beginner-level yoga classes of the visitor`s choice, such as the 'yoga of sound', yoga for strengthening the joints, and yoga for purifying life energies.  Extended retreat packages feature Ayurvedic rejuvenation consultations and therapies; guided hikes and adventure outings to nearby caves, rivers and falls; and even cooking classes to bring home some of your favorite vegetarian delights!  Learn how to mix the pungent, tangy spices of the East, culture farm-fresh milk into yogurt, roll vegetarian sushi, or bake homemade sourdough bread in the Isha center's popular, international kitchen.
For over 30 years, Isha Institute programs have offered the immense benefits of classical yoga and meditation to over 7 million people around the globe. For further details on the Isha retreat center and the programs offered, visit

name: 30s-40s Fellow Indians (Desis) Hiking Meetup Group
location: McKinney Falls State Park, Austin, TX
description:
Welcome to the 30s-40s Desi Hiking Meetup Group!
This group is for outdoor enthusiasts looking to connect with fellow Indians (Desis) who share a love for hiking, biking, camping, rafting, kayaking, and other outdoor adventures.
Whether you're a seasoned hiker or a beginner looking to explore new trails, this is the perfect group for you. Join us for fun and challenging hikes, scenic bike rides, relaxing camping trips, thrilling rafting excursions, and tranquil kayaking adventures. Come meet like-minded individuals, make lasting friendships, and experience the beauty of the outdoors with us!

name: Health and Happiness Group
description:
Our vision is to educate people on scientifically proven breathing and meditation techniques to rejuvenate and restore the health.
The word Health in Sanskrit means "to be established in the self". Body, Mind, and Spirit has to be in a harmony. There are seven layers to our existence - body, breath, mind, intellect, memory, ego and self.  We need to learn a little bit about all these and techniques to keep them healthy and in harmony, and that is what Yoga, Sudarshan Kriya (Breathing Based Meditation) is all about. If we attend to our breath and a few minutes of meditation, our whole system gets rejuvenated. There are four sources of energy - food, sleep, breathing, and meditation. Attending to these four important sources of energy we can restore our health.
We are enthusiastic volunteers from Art of Living.The Art of Living is more of a principle, a philosophy of living life to its fullest. It is more a movement than an organization. Its core value is to find peace within oneself and to unite people in our society – of different cultures, traditions, religions, nationalities; and thus reminding us all that we have one goal to uplift human life everywhere. Art of Living is active in more than 152 countries and millions of people have achieved health and happiness through ancient techniques.

name: Austin Asian Foodies
description: Austin Asian Foodie Femmes is a group of welcoming ladies who like Asian food. We come from all kinds of backgrounds and share a love for Asian food. Sometimes we cook together but we mostly eat out together. We talk about lady things, travel, and drink sake.

name: KhushATX - South Asian / Desi LGBTQ
description: Welcome to KhushATX! We are so glad you found us!! :) We are an active (since 2012) South Asian gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender, and queer (LGBTQ) group in the Austin area catering to individuals of Indian, Pakistani, Nepali, Sri Lankan, Bangladeshi, and other South Asian descents. This is a social group where we meet and participate in social events, enjoy each other's company and build friendships. Some of the types of events we have are potlucks, chai-gupshups, and dance events.The group is helped by part-time volunteers, helpers and members. name: Austin South Asian Bookclub Meetup Group
location: Austin Public Library Hampton Branch at Oak Hill, Austin, TX
description:
Welcome to our diverse community of writers and readers! Our monthly social gathering is a safe and inclusive space where we explore stories from all backgrounds and perspectives. Our discussions revolve around sharing our favorite books, with a focus on diverse and usually South-Asian literature.
We believe in fostering a supportive environment for everyone to express their creativity and gain confidence in their writing abilities. Whether you're an experienced writer or simply enjoy reading and discussing stories, we welcome you to join us.
Our two-hour meetings cover a range of topics, including introductions and an open sharing session where members can discuss their own writing projects and provide constructive feedback to one another.
We're proud to be sponsored by, an Austin-based nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting inclusivity through storytelling. By joining our group, you're contributing to a movement towards a more diverse and understanding world, one story at a time. Come join us and let's inspire each other!
